summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a large obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised purpose
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-tagged bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotator loader, hex-only identifiers, opaque integer array) with no readable strings and no discernible relation to the advertised Salesforce Messaging-for-In-App-and-Web client. The name `math_init.js` and the alternate-runtime execution path serve as cover for running opaque code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The delivery pattern — installer-triggered fetch of an alternate runtime specifically to run an obfuscated in-tree payload that has nothing to do with the package's stated function — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
